summary: Taysha Gene Therapies filed a Form 8-K (Items 7.01 & 8.01) disclosing the completion of dosing in the REVEAL pivotal trial for TSHA-102 in Rett syndrome and longer-term clinical data. The press release and presentation provide clinical and regulatory updates, including enrollment, safety, and efficacy milestones, but no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is a routine clinical trial update and not an event-driven special situation.
